lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg14Mn4 (reduced formula Mg7Mn2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Mg and Mn sites each show 12 geometric neighbors, with Mg–Mg distances near 3.09–3.25 Å and Mn–Mg near 2.91–3.19 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra connected through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
